children: Nvidia PC Senior Vice President Jeff Fisher said the RTX 5090 graphics card has not been discontinued. According to Odaily, Fisher described the RTX 5090 as a core product and said Nvidia will continue supplying it. He acknowledged that production capacity across the supply chain remains limited and said Nvidia is working to bring the product to market.

title: Nvidia Says RTX 5090 Is Not Discontinued and Will Remain in Supply
